    StartersPhilly cheesesteak bitesShaved rib eye and melted provolone in mini rollsHow to make it400g rib eye steak1 brown onion6 slices of provolone12 mini bread rolls2 tbsp vegetable oilFreeze the steak for 30 minutes so it firms up, then shave as thin as you can.Sear the onion on a hot plate in oil until soft, then push aside and sear the beef quickly.Lay the provolone over the meat to melt.Split the rolls and pile the filling in.Italian Market antipastoSalami, prosciutto, provolone, artichokes, olives and roasted peppers, crusty breadHow to make it100g salami100g prosciutto150g provolone1 jar artichoke hearts1 jar olives1 jar roasted capsicum1 Italian loafDrain the artichokes, olives and capsicum.Arrange the salami, prosciutto and sliced provolone on a board with the jar items.Serve with the loaf torn into pieces.Philly soft pretzels with beer cheeseA Philly street snackHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chewy figure-eight pretzels dipped in hot bicarb water, baked deep brown with rock salt, served with yellow mustard and a sharp cheddar beer cheese dip.Mix 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour.Roll 8 ropes and twist into figure eights.Dip each for 30 seconds in 2L simmering water with 80g bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml lager and 200g grated cheddar until smooth.MainsMeat locker steakCast iron seared sirloin basted in garlic thyme butter, with roast potatoesHow to make it4 sirloin steaks1 tsp cracked black pepper1 tbsp salt40g butter2 garlic cloves1 bunch thyme1kg potatoesDry-brine the steaks with salt, uncovered in the fridge overnight.Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in oil and roast at 220°C until crisp.Season the steaks with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute.Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste until the steaks reach 54°C inside.Rest the steaks before serving with the potatoes.Paulie's Thanksgiving turkey and stuffingThe turkey Paulie throws out the back doorHow to make itAs written, serves 4Brined turkey breast roasted golden and sliced thick, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy.Keep it on the table.Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar.Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170°C to 70°C inside, about 80 minutes, then rest 15 minutes.Mix 200g torn bread with a sauteed onion, 40g butter, sage and an egg and bake 30 minutes.Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer for gravy.Serve with cranberry sauce.SweetsPecan caramel turtle clustersToasted pecans with caramel and dark chocolate, shaped like little turtlesHow to make it150g pecans200g caramels30ml thickened cream100g dark chocolateToast the pecans in a dry pan and arrange in clusters of four on baking paper.Melt the caramels with the cream and spoon over each cluster.Melt the chocolate and spoon over the top.Set in the fridge until firm.DrinksTraining shakeBanana, milk, peanut butter and oats blended thick, no raw eggsHow to make it2 ripe bananas800ml full cream milk2 tbsp peanut butter40g rolled oats1 tbsp honeyBlend the ripe bananas, full cream milk, peanut butter, rolled oats and honey until thick and smooth.Pour into four glasses.
